name: @w6w-apps/superchat
description: Send WhatsApp, SMS, email and social messages, and manage contacts, conversations, notes, templates and webhooks in Superchat.

w6w.longDescription:
Superchat is a shared inbox for customer messaging — WhatsApp, SMS, email, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, Telegram and a web chat widget in one workspace — and this app drives it from a workflow through one API key.

Its centre is a single Send Message action that works across every connected channel: pass a channel, a recipient (a contact, an E.164 phone number or an email address; an unknown one creates the contact) and a content type — text, media, email, generic or WhatsApp template, quick reply or list. Templates, template folders, files and message delivery analytics are covered, so a workflow can start a WhatsApp conversation with an approved template and later read whether it was delivered, read or clicked.

The rest is the CRM around those messages: create, search, update and delete contacts and custom attributes, manage contact lists, read and update conversations (status, assignee, labels, snooze), keep internal notes, export a conversation, and manage the webhook subscriptions that report inbound messages and contact changes back out. Health checks cover Superchat's own status page and API reachability; webhook signing secrets are redacted from every read so they do not land in run records.
